notes: always 'digitised_from_figure' in this item. Digitisation: the markers of Fig. 5 were pixel-digitised from the embedded 755 x 945 px bitmap by Heffner_etal_2003_Figure5_extract.py (tick calibration; ring / disc / triangle template matching). Estimated error +/- 0.9% on both axes (log-fit residuals on the printed ticks) plus about 0.3% per pixel of marker centring; four independent checks against numbers printed in this paper agree to 0.0-4.7%. The figure contains 70 plotted points (the caption's n = 67 circles plus three subterranean open triangles); 62 were individually resolved (51 open circles, 8 filled circles, 3 triangles) and 8 circles could NOT be separated from an overlapping neighbour and are absent from this item. No point was inferred. Only 21 of the resolved markers carry a printed label; the other 41 keep Species = NA.
